summary: Fold the owner's remaining PLAN-02 answers and two new scope decisions into the plan. Owner accepted the AI ceilings and then approved the raised ceilings that cover llm_rerank; forbade sending private seed/profile IDs to external recommenders; set PDF storage to a local folder. ADR 0003 allows an explicitly enabled sparse+LLM rerank (default off until measured, labelled, no silent fallback). Adds R-GRAPH/E-GRAPH/GRAPH-01 and the KNOWLEDGE-GRAPH research. No runtime, model call or quality measurement.
